response.sql: SELECT AVG(g.avg_rental_rate) AS avg_of_group_avg_rates, AVG(g.film_count) AS avg_of_group_film_counts FROM (SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY original_language_id) AS g;

assumptions.assumption: The NULL original_language_id films form one group that is included with equal weight in the across-group averages, as the request specifies. AVG ignores NULLs, so a NULL group average or count would be skipped, and the result is NULL only if no groups remain.
rental_rate is NOT NULL in the schema, so no group average is NULL and the only missing-value handling that applies is the NULL original-language group.
